title: Spark Joins & Skew Handling
description: Master the join decisions and skew-mitigation patterns that separate Spark practitioners from Spark sufferers: broadcast vs sort-merge, salting hot partitions, AQE skew handling, fan-out detection, and the OOM scenarios that come from getting any of these wrong.
outcomes: You'll choose the right join strategy from query characteristics, recognise skew before it tanks a job, design salting and AQE skew-join solutions, predict row counts after fan-out joins, and diagnose driver OOMs traced to broadcast misuse.
